vocabulary.definition: the quality of being understandable or easily comprehended
vocabulary.example: The key to effective communication is ensuring the comprehensibility of your message.

vocabulary.definition: the achievement or realization of things one desires or wishes for
vocabulary.example: For many people, winning the lottery is a form of wish-fulfillment.

vocabulary.definition: to talk at length in a confused or inconsequential way
vocabulary.example: He tends to ramble when he gets nervous, making it hard to follow his train of thought.

vocabulary.definition: to go beyond the limits of; exceed or surpass
vocabulary.example: His artistry transcends mere entertainment, touching the hearts of audiences worldwide.

vocabulary.definition: a person who studies human societies and cultures and their development
vocabulary.example: The anthropologist spent years living among the indigenous tribe to understand their customs and traditions.

vocabulary.definition: a long poem, typically one derived from ancient oral tradition, narrating the deeds and adventures of heroic or legendary figures
vocabulary.example: The Odyssey is considered one of the greatest epics of all time, telling the story of Odysseus' journey back home after the Trojan War.
